extras.real_size: chainmail shirt with short sleeves, 75 cm long, on a wooden hanger and stand
extras.notes: hollow mail shirt (6 mm wall, open hem, neck and sleeves) hanging on an ash coat hanger with a brass hook from a small walnut valet stand (round foot, post behind the shirt, arm with knob); the ring pattern is baked into the normal and color maps (no modelled rings), two rows of brass rings above the hem, brass hem and sleeve trims, leather collar; front faces -Y; no moving parts; no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
